profile.headline: Developer | Educator | Muppet
profile.jobTitle: Full Stack Developer - Educational Technology Innovations (ETI)
profile.summary: Elementary educator and curriculum developer turned "glass is half full-stack" software engineer.  I am an adventurous introverted-extrovert who enjoys exploring the unknown and learning from the world and people around me.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer - Educational Technology Innovations (ETI)

company.name: College of Education and Human Development - University of Minnesota

positions.title: User Experience (UX) and Accessibility Developer | IT Dev II
positions.description:
• Develop and support front-end code on residence-facing interfaces with a focus on user experience, universal design, and accessibility standards and practices. 

• Conduct accessibility review on pre-development wireframes and currently existing digital products to ensure compliance with WCAG 2.1 standards and UI best practices

• Offer guidance and assistance in the implementation of accessible code, ranging from various frameworks, component libraries, proprietary products, and low-code rapid application development

• Lead developer for the Hennepin County Design System

positions.title: Frontend Developer | IT Dev I
positions.description:
• Front-end developer for the Service Delivery Technology team for the Information Technology and Records Management division of the Health and Human Services department.  We developed and maintained custom applications that met business needs of the department. 

• Developed UI components with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Typescript/Angular/PrimeNG

• Retrofitted accessible code into applications 

• conducted both manual and automated accessibility testing on code and UI to ensure we met WCAG 2.1 A and AA standards

• Deployed applications to Azure Cloud infrastructure and on-premise IIS servers. 

• Integrated front-end components with RESTful APIs.

• Researched and helped developers from my own team as well as throughout the County (as well as myself) obtain accessibility training through Deque System’s Web Accessibility Bootcamp. 

• Actively collaborated with cross-functional teams

• Utilized and promoted engineering best practices and code quality standards. 

• Participated in daily sprint reviews, planning meetings, and other sprint events.

positions.title: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Developer
positions.description:
• Back-end development, testing, documentation, and implementation of various electronic data interchange solutions

• Kanban methodology – understanding and implementation of flow and various software used in third party global logistics for numerous projects simultaneously – average of 6 new project deploys from testing to Production monthly

• Collaborate with business analysts, various application teams, and infrastructure specialists to deliver complex mapping and workflow problems using IBM Sterling Integrator (C#/Java hybrid)

• Develop, maintain, and enhance maps used for data transformation

• Create data workflow interfaces between application systems and EDI transactions

• Perform Unit testing, API/SQL database calls and program requests, System Integration testing, and support User Acceptance Testing for each project
positions.insights: Skills: Analytical Skills · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Quality Assurance · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Software Development Student
positions.description:
Experience with full-stack coding, advanced JavaScript, React.js, Material-UI, HTML, jQuery, Bootstrap, Node.js, JSON, AJAX, AXIOS, SQL, Git, Encryption, Jest testing, Postman, React-Redux, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Ruby and CSS.  
 
• Solo Project: Culturally-Relevant Guided Reading Database for Parents, Caregivers, and Educators

• Website to help ALL children become lifelong learners and successful global citizens through cultural relevance and diverse book types and formats

• Highly accessible, easily navigable database of books for grades K-5 – consulted UX specialists to ensure accessibility (to be further implemented in version currently being worked on)

• Project aims to end illiteracy and close the Achievement Gap

• Web-based application, developed SQL databases, allows admin to add, modify, and delete books; allows users to browse collection and search using various parameters

• Uses JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Material-UI, CSS, Redux.js, PostgreSQL, Encryption, Postman, CSS, HTML, and Express.js
▪ Group Project: Panacea web application that allows individuals to quickly get access to local health information, especially when in a new country

• Uses JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Material-UI, Redux.js, Google Map API, PostgreSQL, Encryption, Postman, CSS, HTML, and Express.
positions.insights: Skills: Public Speaking · Databases · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) · Communication · Web Applications · Semantic HTML · JavaScript · Analytical Skills · SQL · Accessibility · Full-Stack Development · Quality Assurance · Software Development · React

positions.title: Founder and Director
positions.description:

• Develop integrated curriculum, assessment, and training for educators based upon client needs

positions.title: Director of Curriculum & Professional Development
positions.description:
• Invited to present at the Harvard Graduate School of Education's annual Project Zero Conference (2019)
• Developed culturally relevant, arts and tech integrated curriculum and assessment for African American students in grades K-8 struggling in Literacy
• Training, one-to-one coaching, and professional development for Academic Coaches

positions.title: Lead Elementary Arts Integration Specialist
positions.description:
• Created, organized, and implemented Media Arts using Apple applications into Math and English curriculum for district-wide use
• Dissemination of curriculum and pedagogy to over 200 educators at state and national conferences
• Created and designed main website for access to curriculum and courses for public use
     o Uses HTML, CSS, Adobe After Effect, Adobe Photoshop, and Adobe Premiere Pro

positions.title: Community Projects Coordinator (K-5 English Language Arts)/Americorps VISTA
positions.description:
• Arranged and coordinated large-scale Literacy initiatives for K-5 students with community partners
(Target, Barnes & Noble, Little Free Library)
• Created online resources for parents, community tutors, and volunteers to assist in K-5 literacy knowledge
• Created thematic, integrated curriculum for district-wide use

positions.title: Arts Integrated Curriculum Developer
positions.description:
• Created arts-integrated curriculum for grades K-5 to be used as an educational teaching tool with the Beacon’s Bluff Park Project
• Focused on works of art created for Beacon’s Bluff and integrated it into both science and social
studies-based lessons.
positions.insights: Skills: Curriculum Development · Elementary Education · Communication · Research · Consulting · Community Outreach

positions.title: Loss Mitigation Specialist
positions.description:
• Home Affordable Modification Program (HAMP)/Making Homes Affordable Program and general modification specialist.  
• Assisted struggling home and property owners assess their debt-to-income ratio to minimize loss due to foreclosure through the use of loss mitigation options.   
• Answered inbound inquiries from borrowers regarding the status of their loss mitigation, loan modification, collections, short sales, or foreclosure processes.  
• Strong ability to empathize/sympathize with borrowers under significant financial strain 
• Knowledge of of changing policies and procedures at high volumes of inquires and requests.

positions.description:

•	Assisted the head professor by working with small groups within a large classroom setting
